# Third-party code in this folder

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `noble.js` | [@noble/secp256k1](https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-secp256k1) | 2.3.0 | MIT |
| `noble.js` | [@noble/hashes](https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-hashes) (`sha2`, `hmac`) | 1.8.0 | MIT |

`noble.js` is an esbuild bundle (`--format=esm`) of the two unmodified npm packages. Full license text: `LICENSE-noble.txt` (both packages carry the same MIT notice by Paul Miller).
